text: Do these five things before that money starts disappearing.
One, check which bills are due before your next paycheck.
If rent's due before you get paid again, set that money aside now so it's there when you need it.
Two, figure out how much you'll need for gas and groceries till next payday.
Look at what you spent last time.
That gives you a number to start with.
Three, move some money into savings on payday.
Even if it's 20 bucks, transfer it now.
It's easy to spend it when it's still sitting in your checking account.
Four, if you've got credit card debt, cover the minimum on every card.
Then put any extra toward the card with the highest interest rate.
That's the one charging you the most for every dollar you owe.
Five, give yourself a limit for fun money.
If you set aside 80 bucks, that's 80 total for eating out, hanging out, whatever, until your next check.
Save this and pull it up next payday.
